caption: Supplementary Fig. 29 | Regional recurrence and recovery support. a, Genesis-basin fractions under two distinct definitions applied to the same 2,340 main-sample histories: anchored near-peak returns, and the retained post-first-LMI episodes satisfying the separate 10-kt-in-24-hour strengthening definition. Error bars are 95% SID-bootstrap intervals. b, Outcome composition among model-supported first eligible departures, assigned by departure location; labels give regional cyclone counts. Unknown outcomes remain separate. c, Natural-course recovery predictions with fixed-model conditional 95% intervals; these differ from bounds implied by unknown observations. d,e, South China Sea return-minus-complete-nonreturn contrasts in integrated horizontal advection, vertical advection, residual and moving-frame moisture tendency, for the 100–300 and 300–800 km annuli. Waterfall steps retain the original component arithmetic; diagnostic-specific counts and intervals are reported in the corresponding tables. The SCS subset has 94 eligible departures; the Japan Sea box has none.
